svg.text: Smart Room Controller - one full simulated day (08:50 to 23:00), all signals, rendered from the testbench simulation
Time axis in simulation microseconds (1 simulated second = 100 clock cycles); 41 signals shown. Numbers are decimal except alarm_flags (binary).
SOUND (0 off,1 ok,2 no,3 warn,4 alarm,5 siren)
